fees.description: This fee may be charged when the network disconnect the power to your property remotely.
This fee may be charged when the network reconnect the power to your property remotely.

This fee may apply when the network is requested to visit site and undertake a special meter read. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.
Additional fees and charges may apply. Please see the Nectr fee schedules at nectr.com.au/plans-and-fees/united-energy/.

electricityContract.terms: For further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please visit nectr.com.au/legal/#contracts or contact Nectr on hello@nectr.com.au or call 1300 111 211.
electricityContract.variation: We will publish price variations via our website (and newspaper) at least 10 business days prior to the new prices starting. You will also be notified at least 5 business days prior to the change starting.

eligibility.information: This offer is available to customers with an applicable network tariff. If you are not sure which network tariff you have, please contact us or sign-up online to check this offer is available to you.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: This offer has no contract term.
